transcript: Outdoor frost-free sillcock replacement for Derek Young, 908 Highland Terrace. Old spigot split from freeze damage over winter. Cut out the old pipe in crawlspace and installed a twelve-inch frost-free sillcock valve. Used eight feet of half-inch PEX-A tubing, two brass PEX adapters, and secured the pipe with three copper J-hooks. Took an hour and forty-five minutes labor crawling around underneath. Sillcock is eighty-five dollars.

expected.job_summary: Replaced freeze-damaged outdoor sillcock and crawlspace PEX line
expected.notes: Work completed in crawlspace; tested frost-free shutoff.
